# Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Ensemble in a Broadway Show

| website =
| sponsor = New York City Dance Alliance
}}
The Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Ensemble in a Broadway Show is an annual award presented to a production's ensemble for their work on a Broadway production. The award was first presented in 2017.
The award is for all non-principal ensemble performers in Broadway musicals.
